finding: dispatch close removes 'the premerge-check-ok and verify-base-ok markers of the run' (RL-14, interface-contracts.md line 41). premerge-check writes one file, .current-work/premerge-check-ok, keyed to the head of a branch, and the guardrail reads that path. With two runs active at once, the spec does not say which marker files belong to a run: the one file in the primary checkout, only the markers inside the run's worktrees, or the markers keyed to the run's branches. Name the path of each marker of a run, or state that close removes a marker only when it is keyed to a branch of the run. Owner: domain-modeling-agent.
why_this_severity: Removing a marker keyed to a branch of the run is safe, because a marker only lets a merge of that exact head through, so the implementer can act (no to fails_purpose); the test writer of RL-14-IT-01 must still decide which files the Scenario 'the markers of the run are gone' checks (raises_cost).
